title: Web application verification 01
description: Verify the deployed Analytics dashboard implementation.

criteria.requirement: The deployed page must contain a visible page title, primary navigation with two links, and a three-card metrics section
criteria.passCondition: Retrieved HTML contains the title, two primary navigation links, and three metric cards
criteria.failureCondition: Any required structural element is absent

criteria.requirement: The deployed page must provide a mobile layout at 720px or below
criteria.passCondition: Retrieved CSS includes a max-width 720px media query that changes the hero and metrics to one column
criteria.failureCondition: Responsive CSS is missing or does not change the layout

criteria.requirement: The request form must have associated name and email labels, required controls, a submit button, and accessible success feedback
criteria.passCondition: Retrieved implementation contains associated labels, required inputs, submit handling, and an aria-live status updated after submission
criteria.failureCondition: The form, labels, validation, submit behavior, or accessible feedback is absent
